labelObjects: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX o03_actor_session_ordinal ON actor_registry(session_id, display_ordinal) WHERE display_ordinal IS NOT NULL

CREATE TRIGGER o03_session_ordinal_insert BEFORE INSERT ON session WHEN typeof(NEW.next_display_ordinal) != 'integer' OR NEW.next_display_ordinal < 1 OR NEW.next_display_ordinal > 9007199254740991 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid actor ordinal counter'); END

CREATE TRIGGER o03_session_ordinal_update BEFORE UPDATE OF next_display_ordinal ON session WHEN typeof(NEW.next_display_ordinal) != 'integer' OR NEW.next_display_ordinal != OLD.next_display_ordinal + 1 OR NEW.next_display_ordinal > 9007199254740991 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid actor ordinal counter'); END

CREATE TRIGGER o03_actor_label_insert BEFORE INSERT ON actor_registry WHEN CASE WHEN ((NEW.display_ordinal IS NULL AND NEW.display_label IS NULL AND NEW.display_revision IS NULL AND NEW.display_origin IS NULL) OR (typeof(NEW.display_ordinal) = 'integer' AND NEW.display_ordinal > 0 AND NEW.display_ordinal < 9007199254740991 AND NEW.display_ordinal = (SELECT next_display_ordinal - 1 FROM session WHERE id=NEW.session_id) AND typeof(NEW.display_label) = 'text' AND length(CAST(NEW.display_label AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND typeof(NEW.display_revision) = 'integer' AND NEW.display_revision >= 0 AND NEW.display_revision <= 9007199254740991 AND NEW.display_origin IN ('deterministic','helper','manual'))) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid actor label'); END

CREATE TRIGGER o03_actor_label_update BEFORE UPDATE OF display_ordinal, display_label, display_revision, display_origin ON actor_registry WHEN CASE WHEN ((OLD.display_ordinal IS NULL AND OLD.display_label IS NULL AND OLD.display_revision IS NULL AND OLD.display_origin IS NULL AND typeof(NEW.display_ordinal) = 'integer' AND NEW.display_ordinal > 0 AND NEW.display_ordinal < 9007199254740991 AND NEW.display_ordinal = (SELECT next_display_ordinal - 1 FROM session WHERE id=NEW.session_id) AND typeof(NEW.display_label) = 'text' AND length(CAST(NEW.display_label AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND NEW.display_revision = 0 AND NEW.display_origin = 'deterministic') OR (OLD.display_ordinal IS NOT NULL AND NEW.display_ordinal IS OLD.display_ordinal AND typeof(NEW.display_label) = 'text' AND length(CAST(NEW.display_label AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND typeof(NEW.display_revision) = 'integer' AND NEW.display_revision = OLD.display_revision + 1 AND NEW.display_revision <= 9007199254740991 AND NEW.display_origin IN ('helper','manual') AND (OLD.display_origin != 'manual' OR NEW.display_origin = 'manual'))) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid actor label transition'); END

CREATE TRIGGER o03_actor_session_update BEFORE UPDATE OF session_id ON actor_registry WHEN OLD.display_ordinal IS NOT NULL AND NEW.session_id IS NOT OLD.session_id BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'actor label session immutable'); END
